description: Build a multi-page Site Analysis PDF for one lat/lon (power and transmission, gas, water, air permitting, fiber, latency, market, tax) and return its survey data and a download link valid for about 7 days. Needs a DC Hub account with site-analysis access; without one it returns only a notice.

capacity_mw.description: Target power load for the build in megawatts (MW), e.g. 150 (typical 50-500)

lat.description: Site latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90, required), e.g. 37.694

latency_target.description: Optional metro to measure latency against; default = nearest real carrier hotel

latitude.description: Alias for lat — either name works

lng.description: Alias for lon — either name works

lon.description: Site longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180, required), e.g. -88.65

longitude.description: Alias for lon — either name works

prepared_by.description: Your firm name that brands the report; defaults to DC Hub, e.g. "Martone Advisors"

prepared_for.description: Client name printed on the report cover, e.g. "TON Infrastructure"

use_case.description: Optional workload descriptor to tailor the report, e.g. "AI training campus"

name: generate_site_analysis
title: Generate Site Analysis
